create.max_reply_tip: Used to limit the maximum number of Tokens for a single model generation. Tokens are the basic unit of text processing for the model, where roughly 10 Tokens equate to about 15 Chinese characters (length may vary slightly due to punctuation, vocabulary structure, etc.). Setting a reasonable upper limit helps control output length and avoid overly long or redundant content.
create.top_n_tip: During each generation step, the model samples from the smallest vocabulary subset that reaches the cumulative probability threshold (e.g., Top P = 0.9). This means it only considers the currently most likely words, dynamically adjusting the candidate range rather than fixedly selecting the top P words. This method enhances the reasonableness and coherence of the output while preserving linguistic diversity. Since its mechanism overlaps partially with 'Generate Randomness', it is generally recommended to adjust only one of the two for more predictable generation results.

create.decision_score: Score: A score must be provided. This score reflects how well the model's output meets the given criteria. A score of 1.0 means the output fully complies with the criteria, while a score of 0.0 means it does not meet the criteria at all.
create.decision_reason: Reason: Provide a one-sentence summary of the scoring reason, highlighting which parts of the output meet the criteria and which are missing or incorrect.

evaluation_task.title: You have no evaluation tasks. Let's create one now.
evaluation_task.desc: Evaluation is a multi-dimensional automatic check on the output of an agent, such as correctness, relevance, and instruction compliance.

one.title: Create Evaluation Dataset
one.desc: to create an evaluation dataset, including the input and reference output. Before starting an evaluation task, you need to prepare an evaluation dataset.

two.title: Create Evaluator
two.desc: to create a model-based evaluator or code-based evaluator. An evaluator acts as a referee to quantify the results.

three.title: Create Evaluation Task
three.desc: to create an evaluation task. Select the evaluation object, evaluation dataset, and evaluator. Start the evaluation task and view the result.

evaluator.title: You have no evaluators. Let's create one now.
evaluator.desc: An evaluator defines evaluation criteria. It helps you tell the difference between the reference output and the actual output. An evaluator acts as a referee to quantify the output of the evaluation object to evaluate the performance of the agent task.

one.title: Configure Evaluation Rules
one.desc: Define evaluation rules for the evaluator based on evaluation requirements.

two.title: Debug
two.desc: Enter test data to verify the evaluation logic and confirm that the results match expectations.

three.title: Save Evaluator
three.desc: Publish the evaluator version for use in upcoming evaluation tasks.
